title: Coherent Polarized Signals in a Substantial Fraction of Sampled Noise-Labeled STEAD Traces
question: Within the STEAD three-component traces labeled 'noise' (no cataloged source), what fraction exhibit statistically anomalous, cross-component-coherent transient energy bursts -- with polarization and STA/LTA signatures resembling a genuine body-wave arrival rather than incoherent stationary background -- and does this prevalence differ systematically by channel/instrument type (BH/EH/HH/HN/SH) or network?

dataset: DECaLS + SDSS -- 210 images of 105 shared galaxies
title: Consistent Morphological Classifications from a General-Purpose Vision-Language Model Across Deep and Shallow Imaging of the Same Galaxies
question: For the same galaxies imaged by both DECaLS (deep) and SDSS (shallow), does a general-purpose VLM's morphological classification accuracy drop specifically for SDSS relative to DECaLS, and -- among true spiral/edge_on galaxies -- do SDSS errors disproportionately collapse toward the featureless 'smooth' label compared to DECaLS errors on the identical objects?

title: Reduced Discriminability of a Mid/High-Band Acoustic Bird-Presence Classifier Under Increasing Background Noise in freefield1010
question: Within the freefield1010 benchmark, is the acoustic separability of the hasbird label (using simple, non-deep spectro-temporal features) uniform across recordings, or does it degrade systematically in clips with heavier low-frequency background masking energy (e.g., wind/traffic rumble), independent of the label itself?
